main_text.p: rursum degeneravit in Papismum, ac priori {a}be-stiae, Apoc. 13. ver.2.scilicet civili imperio Romano, successit {b}po-sterior, ver.11.monarchia nempe Pontificia: vos, quibus Cardinalis Alanus aliique huiusmodi mercatores Romam importandis naviter infudárunt, infignif[?]-simo estis exemplo, quemadmodum negotientur animas hominum. Nam Romanus Pontifex sentét.decla-rat.cót. Eliz. Angl.Regin.pecu-niam quidem grandem (ut {c}Alanus refert) Apolog.pro Seminar ca 2expendit immutando xenodochium Anglicum Romæ Bellarm. de Rom. Pont. li.5.ca.6 & 7in Collegium, censibúique augendo, ac Rhemen-se[?] etiam Collegiū fovendo menstrua eleemosyna: sed in eum finem, quæ {d}Concilior. lib.3 de Regularib.cof.1Martinus Navarrus his verbis evulgavit; Romæ in Collegio Anglorum est statutum & constitutio Papalis, ui[?], quicunque illud ingre-di voluerit, teneatur iurare, se post tot annos pro defen-sione fidei Catholicæ in Angliam professurū[?], illamq; ibi publicè & privatè prædicaturum. Fides autem Pa-pistica, quam Catholicam vocat, {e}Cócil.Trid. sess.14.cap.7.Romano Pontifici in universa Ecclesia supremam tribuit potestatem, & {f}Papæ ii.V.licentiam absolvendi subditos omni debito fidelitatis & obsequij, eósque {*}Sanderus & alij plerique Nobiles & Catholici, freti Bulla Pij 5. in Hibernia contra Angliæ Reginam bella pro patria & religione gerunt.contra Principes suos armádi. unde, qui ob huius doctrinæ defensionem Trophæ Ecclesiæ Angli canæ.Cöcer-tat. Ecclef. Cath.in Ang.adver.Calv.& Purit.in Indice perfo-narum.morti adiudicati sunt, Genebrard. Chronogr.li. 4.ad annum Dom.1581.eos ob Catholicam fidè passos § dicunt. Quare quú in Angliam venire non possitis ad fidè hanc prædicandam, quin teneamini criminè læsæ Maiestatis: certè animas vestras negotiantur isti, qui ad talè operá vos nundinantur. Atq; utinam eis pro mercibus haberent duntaxat quem in morem habebát negotiatores Babylonis Ethni-cæ. Ita temporariæ vitæ dispendio satisfaceretis illorum avaritiæ: {h}Damnati ad bestias Christiani. Quod factitatum & historia Ecclef. refert in Ignatio alij que: & Tertull. innuit,multi, quos calamitas conditio-nis suæ pugnare cum bestiis coegit, defuncti
{h} quum voces crebrò ab Ethnicis usurpatas memorat; Christiani ad leonem, Christiani ad bestias.Apol.c.40.Exhort.castit.c.13.

page.notes: Reference marks in the text and the margin do not all line up. The mark "*" is printed in the text beside "contra", but its margin note sits higher, beside the Sanderus passage; the note is placed at the text mark. No mark "g" appears in the text, so the Trophæ note is placed beside "suos armádi". Doubtful readings: "infignif-" (marked [?]); "ui" after "Papalis," (could be "ut"; marked [?]); "Rhemen-se" with the first word of the next line uncertain; "professurū" (marked [?]); "duntaxat quem" with a possibly abbreviated "quem"; "quú" in "Quare quú"; "§" at the end of "fidè passos". Underlining and ink marks on the page are handwriting and were left out. The sign "✱" before "Anglorum" was not counted as printed text.
